notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature without summoning sickness you control.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
easyPrerequisites: You control nine or fewer lands.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and [[Permanent with Landfall Ability|Landfall Girl]].
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the [[Landfall Girl]] trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
